grammar.example: The museum was beautiful. The paintings were old.
Frida Kahlo was a Mexican painter.
We were at the museum all day.
Was it interesting? — Yes, it was.
grammar.en: Questions in the past with "to be"

tips.en: "Was" and "were" mean both "era/estaba" and "fue/estuvo": English has one past for "to be".
tips.es: «Was» y «were» significan «era/estaba» y también «fue/estuvo»: el inglés tiene un solo pasado para «to be».

tips.en: Many museums in the US are free on certain days. Look for "free admission" days.
tips.es: Muchos museos en Estados Unidos son gratis ciertos días. Busca los días de «free admission».

tips.en: "Painting" is the picture; "painter" is the person who paints.
tips.es: «Painting» es el cuadro; «painter» es la persona que pinta.

tips.en: In a museum, "Please don't touch" signs are serious. Photos are often allowed without flash.
tips.es: En un museo, los letreros «Please don't touch» son serios. Las fotos suelen estar permitidas sin flash.

tips.en: "Gift shop" is the museum store, usually near the exit.
tips.es: La «gift shop» es la tienda del museo, normalmente cerca de la salida.

question.en: The person who paints is a…
question.es: La persona que pinta es un/a…

explanation.en: Painter = la persona; painting = el cuadro.
explanation.es: Painter = la persona; painting = el cuadro.

question.en: Complete: "Frida Kahlo ___ a famous Mexican painter."
question.es: Completa: «Frida Kahlo ___ a famous Mexican painter.»

explanation.en: She → was (she lived in the past).

explanation.en: You → were. Question: Where were you…?
explanation.es: You → were. Pregunta: Where were you…?

story.title: Frida in San Diego
story.text: Last Saturday was a special day. There was an exhibition of Frida Kahlo's paintings at a museum in Balboa Park. Carmen and Ana were there at ten in the morning. The tickets weren't expensive, and there was a free guided tour. The guide was a young woman from Monterrey. "Frida was a Mexican painter," she said. "Her paintings were very colorful and very personal." Carmen was very emotional. "When I was a girl, my mother had a book about Frida," she told Ana. The museum was crowded, but it wasn't noisy. At the end, they were in the gift shop for half an hour. Carmen bought a postcard for her sister. On Monday, Mr. Park asked, "Where were you on Saturday?" "I was with Frida!" said Carmen.
story.es: El sábado pasado fue un día especial. Había una exposición de pinturas de Frida Kahlo en un museo del Parque Balboa. Carmen y Ana estuvieron ahí a las diez de la mañana. Los boletos no eran caros y había una visita guiada gratis. La guía era una joven de Monterrey. «Frida fue una pintora mexicana», dijo. «Sus pinturas eran muy coloridas y muy personales.» Carmen estaba muy emocionada. «Cuando yo era niña, mi madre tenía un libro sobre Frida», le contó a Ana. El museo estaba lleno, pero no había ruido. Al final, estuvieron media hora en la tienda de recuerdos. Carmen compró una postal para su hermana. El lunes, el señor Park preguntó: «¿Dónde estuvieron el sábado?» «¡Estuve con Frida!», dijo Carmen.
